title: Glowing volcano
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sky glow behind volcano -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='46' ry='20' fill='#3a1a4a' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- main volcano body -->
  <path d='M15 82 L38 30 L62 30 L85 82 Z' fill='#8a4a2a'/>
  <!-- lighter highlight on left side -->
  <path d='M15 82 L38 30 L50 30 L38 82 Z' fill='#a86a3a'/>
  <!-- crater rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='13' ry='5' fill='#c47a3a'/>
  <!-- lava inside crater -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='9' ry='3.5' fill='#ff6a00'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='33' rx='6' ry='2' fill='#ffd24a'/>
  <!-- lava flow down right side -->
  <path d='M55 35 Q58 48 56 56 Q54 64 58 72 Q60 78 57 82' fill='none' stroke='#ff6a00' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M55 35 Q58 48 56 56 Q54 64 58 72 Q60 78 57 82' fill='none' stroke='#ffd24a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- lava flow down left side -->
  <path d='M44 36 Q40 46 42 54 Q44 62 40 70' fill='none' stroke='#ff6a00' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M44 36 Q40 46 42 54 Q44 62 40 70' fill='none' stroke='#ffb030' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- glowing embers floating above -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='20' r='2.5' fill='#ff8a00'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='15' r='2' fill='#ffb030'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='22' r='1.8' fill='#ff6a00'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='16' r='1.5' fill='#ffd24a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='10' r='1.8' fill='#ff8a00'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='14' r='1.5' fill='#ffb030'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='25' r='1.8' fill='#ff8a00'/>
  <!-- small sparkle details -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='20' r='1' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='12' r='1' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <!-- ground shadow at base -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='38' ry='5' fill='#5a2a1a'/>
</svg>
